title: Concept: Software licence key in a response
description: A licence key or serial number field in a response gives every reader the same view the bank has internally: A licence key is a credential for a paid product; published in a page it invites reuse and, for server products, can unlock the same edition elsewhere.
applicability: Admin consoles, about pages and support bundles.
risk: Key reuse undermines the vendor contract and can expose the account the key is bound to.
